privacyModel: Proposed anonymous aggregate counts only. Do not send or persist IP addresses, cookies, raw referrers, email addresses, full search terms, Amazon account data, or user identifiers.

events.name: page_view
events.purpose: Count a page load by path and UTC day.

events.name: guide_open
events.purpose: Count a guide page open by guide path and UTC day.

events.name: site_search
events.purpose: Count a local search submission and its result count; never send the entered query.

events.name: outbound_click
events.purpose: Count an outbound product-link click by internal record ID, page, and UTC day.

events.name: reader_signup
events.purpose: Count a confirmed opt-in only after a consented reader-capture service is configured. The request must include confirmed=true; the server validates then discards that flag before aggregation. This build has no signup form and emits no signup event.

conversionMeasurement: Amazon-reported orders are not inferred from client events. Import only from an authorized first-party Associates report and record its export date and provenance in campaign-ledger.json.
specificationStatus: Proposal only: the request mentions five events but does not specify names, triggers, payloads, consent gates, or retention. Confirm before treating this schema as accepted or enabling a production endpoint.
